# Earnest

> One home for a creative studio — clients, projects, invoices, proposals, client approvals and content in one place, with an AI that reads across all of it and drafts the day with you.

Earnest replaces the pile of disconnected tools — CRM, project management, invoicing, proposals and contracts, client approvals, scheduling, team chat, content planning — with one workspace. It runs on a real large language model (Anthropic's Claude, under no-training terms) grounded in your own organization rather than a blank prompt.

## Key information

- Website: https://earnest.guru
- App: https://app.earnest.guru
- Pricing: Solo $49/mo, Studio $149/mo, Agency $299/mo — priced per workspace, not per action
- Every feature is on every plan. Plans differ by capacity only: seats, AI tokens, file storage, card scans, client-portal seats.
- Free trial: 14 days, no card required.

## How it works

- The home sorts the day into three piles: Decide (drafted by Earnest, waiting on you), Do (one tap each), Know (nothing required, but worth knowing).
- Four lenses re-rank that same home: Everything, Money, Creative, Projects.
- One door: a single control in the header opens Earnest full screen, with its opening suggestions already ranked for whatever you were looking at.
- Three looks: Glass, Paper (ink on linen) and Clean (white on white, one signal blue). They are real redesigns, not colour swaps.
- Nothing reaches a client and no money moves without an explicit human tap.

## What Earnest does not do

Stated plainly, because the rest of this file is a sales document and this part is not:

- Publishing directly to Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, TikTok or Threads is NOT available yet — it is coming soon. Earnest drafts content, plans it, and gets it approved by the client today; a person still performs the send.
- There is no unified social inbox and no social-media analytics.
- Creative Approvals is included on every plan today at no extra charge.

## Features

### Home

- Home — Decide, Do, Know: Your home opens on a greeting with an honest read of the day — “22 things today — 5 need a decision, 13 are one tap each, 4 are just worth knowing” — then sorts everything into three piles
- Lenses & the ambient field: One home, four ways of reading it
- Earnest Score: The Earnest Score tracks six dimensions of performance — follow-through, consistency, responsiveness, proactivity, depth, and CRM activity — and distills them into a single daily score with a team leaderboard
- Daily digest & web push: One honest summary a day — what moved, what is waiting on you, what went quiet — and a web push only when something genuinely cannot wait for it
- Spotlight search: One keystroke over every record you have — clients, contacts, projects, tasks, tickets, invoices, proposals, files and messages — with the result opening in place rather than navigating you somewhere and losing your context
- Learning goals: Set what you are making time to get better at, and Earnest keeps it in front of you with a one-tap timer on the home

### Earnest — the one door

- Focus — one door to Earnest: The header is three controls: search, your avatar, and “E.” — the door

### People

- People & Companies: Clients, contacts, leads, and networking connections in one People app
- Pursuits: Leads and pipeline merged into one lens on the People app
- People Intelligence: An Intelligence tab right inside People
- CardDesk: Turn every business card and networking event into a CRM relationship
- Booking page & My Card: A public page that is both your profile and your scheduler: your CardDesk business card beside your real availability, so someone can read who you are and take a slot in the same breath
- Client Portal: Give every client their own login to see exactly what you choose — projects, tickets, invoices, proposals, contracts, social content, and marketing — under their own brand-matched experience
- Access Control: Role-based client visibility with team assignments and individual overrides

### Work

- Workspaces: Every client and project gets a full workspace with parity tabs — Overview, Conversations, Tasks, Tickets, Time, Documents, Billing, Activity
- Creative Approvals: A board of work, out with a client at its own link
- QuickSend: Send work for approval in one press
- Project Management: Kanban boards, task lists, a timeline, tickets, file attachments, and a command-center project dashboard with stats, documents, billing, and activity feeds
- Quick Tasks & AI To-Dos: Personal task lists with AI-powered suggestions, day and week scheduling, motivational progress tracking, and confetti celebrations
- Calendar & Scheduling: Calendar-first scheduling with meetings, follow-ups, and lead touchpoints on one view
- Meetings & AI Recap: Every Earnest meeting room auto-records and transcribes live the moment the host joins — and the same Earnest is right there in the room, following the conversation as it happens
- Phone & Video: Twilio-powered calling and Daily.co video meetings linked to your CRM pipeline
- Time Tracking & Retainers: Track time against any project and run hourly retainers as first-class projects with a live hour-pool meter on every entry
- Service Offerings: A per-org library of the services you actually sell — name, color, base price, deliverables, scope tree, and timeline

### Money

- Cash Flow & AR Aging: The Money app opens on cash flow: outstanding, overdue, billed-this-month, and collected — with a true AR aging bar (not-yet-due, 1–30, 31–60, 61–90, 90+)
- Invoicing & Billing: Send branded, themed invoices with rich line items — descriptions formatted with Tiptap, time-block tables pulled from your tracker, manual payment recording for cash/check/ACH, and automatic Stripe Connect processing for online payments
- Accept Payments: Stripe Connect Standard powers payment acceptance — your customers pay you direct, Earnest never touches the funds
- Expenses & Bank Sync: Connect your business bank and credit-card accounts via Plaid and Earnest pulls transactions in automatically
- Proposals & Contracts: Build proposals and contracts from a reusable block library — bios, terms, pricing, deliverables, NDAs — and ship them as official, branded documents
- Money Pipeline: See exactly where every dollar is — banked, owed, and still out there
- Pitch pages: A pitch as its own page rather than an attachment, drafted with Earnest from what it already knows about the client
- Retainers → invoices: A retainer that rolls into an invoice on its own schedule, with the hours logged against it already attached
- Pursuit Tracking: Track every pitch through its whole life — including the ones that go cold or get rejected
- Reusable Document Blocks: A per-org library of reusable blocks — bio, references, deliverables, terms, NDA, case studies — that compose into proposals and contracts via a drag-and-drop composer
- Document Themes: Pick one theme on the org settings page and every invoice, proposal, and contract picks it up — including the PDF export and public payment + signing pages

### Marketing

- Marketing Pulse: The Marketing app opens on a Pulse: a marketing health score plus posts, email subscribers, social reach, and contacts at a glance
- Marketing Recommendations: Earnest watches your CRM, social, and email for signals — new leads, lapsed contacts, milestone moments — and proposes ready-to-send marketing touches as a feed of campaign cards
- Content Studio: Social posts and campaign emails share one studio — what is drafted, what is out for review, and what is planned next, in the order it happens
- Email Marketing AI: Block-based newsletter builder with AI-powered content generation
- Brand Awareness AI: Set brand direction, goals, target audience, and location per client

### Chat & the Boardroom

- Channels: A comms hub built for the work — a top-level app on the Earnest rail
- Teams & Members: Invite members, build teams, and assign clients per team so access is scoped to the people who should see it
- The Boardroom: The same Earnest, sized up to a full room

### Organization

- Brand & Strategy: Your organization profile holds brand direction, goals, target audience, and location — the strategic context Earnest reads everywhere
- Whitelabel: A single org-level toggle hides "Powered by Earnest." across every client-facing surface — proposals, contracts, invoices, public sign pages, and the portal
- Branded Email: Send transactional and marketing email from your own brand shell
- AI Token Management: Admins control AI usage per member — set monthly budgets, toggle access on and off, and monitor usage across the team
- Files & storage: A files floor inside your organization rather than a separate drive to keep in sync — folders per client and per project, with the documents Earnest generates landing where they belong

### Looks & the shell

- The shell: One shell over the whole app: six circular chips on a floating rail — Dashboard, People, Work, Chat, Money, Mktg — with the Boardroom in its own footer group, and pill-segmented floor strips inside each app
- Looks, type & contrast: Three looks, and they are real redesigns rather than a colour swap
